basis: Four timezone-dependent assertions in 30_backfill_survival.sql compared a timestamptz rendered with ::text against literals pinned to '+00'. timestamptz::text renders in the session TimeZone, so the suite went green in CI by accident of the runner's clock (PGlite is GMT, GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest is UTC). The four now compare instants via a new test_support.assert_instant; the runner pins the session TimeZone as defence in depth with a documented DB_TEST_TIMEZONE override; and CI runs the suite a second time in a non-UTC session so the regression cannot return silently. Test and CI files only: tests/db/**, scripts/run-db-tests.mjs, .github/workflows/ci.yml. No production code and no engine or migration change, so nothing here touches auth, permissions or personal data and the CTO migration-approval path is not engaged. This claim carries no Reviewed-by trailer: the commit is UNREVIEWED and is raised to MediaTech (CTO) for review in AFC-202 rather than claiming a reviewer that does not exist.
